sees: A black silhouette of a girl with a ponytail stands on the left, pointing right toward three dark abstract bust shapes (a circle for a head over a dome for shoulders) lined up behind a gray bar/table. Faint target/crosshair rings sit in the background, with a small gray easel-like A-frame. The header reads 'INSIGHT 01 / 08 · SETUP' and 'WE WERE LIARS'.
message: The narrator introduces the main character and the group of people around her, maybe her family or friends, at the start of the story.
wouldConfuse: The figures have no faces and are different sizes, so you cannot tell who they are (family? friends? the 'Liars'?). The crosshair target background suggests someone is being targeted or aimed at, which may have nothing to do with the narration.

sees: An extreme close-up of a brown-skinned cartoon girl with glasses, a ponytail and a flat, neutral mouth, filling the right half of the frame. Behind her are faint target rings and a gray bar. Header reads 'INSIGHT 01 / 08 · SETUP' and 'WE WERE LIARS'.
message: The narrator is introducing the narrator or protagonist, a teenage girl, and hinting at how she feels.
wouldConfuse: Her expression is blank to slightly uneasy, so the emotional tone is unclear. A silhouette version of the same character appears in other frames, which could make viewers think these are two different people.

sees: The black ponytailed silhouette girl on the left points at a huge dark navy circle that fills most of the right side of the frame. The circle has nothing in it. Target rings are faint in the background. Same header.
message: The narrator refers to something big, unknown or overwhelming in the girl's life, perhaps a mystery or a blank in her memory.
wouldConfuse: The empty dark circle has no clear meaning. It could be read as a hole, a void, a planet, a spotlight, or just a rendering glitch or a placeholder that never loaded.

sees: The silhouette girl stands with her arms at her sides, facing a tall dark navy oval on the right, which partly blocks a gray A-frame and bar. Target rings are in the background. Same header.
message: The narrator says the girl is facing something unknown or looming, possibly a gap or a secret.
wouldConfuse: The oval is abstract with no label. It could be read as a mirror, a doorway, an egg, a shadowy person or a missing asset, so it is not clear what it stands for.

sees: The silhouette girl stands passively on the left. On the right is a large smartphone icon with a blank screen and a dark speech bubble with three dots (a typing indicator). Target rings in the background. Same header.
message: The narrator mentions messages, texting or communication, maybe someone waiting for a reply or something left unsaid.
wouldConfuse: A modern smartphone and a typing bubble suggest texting or social media. If the story is about summers on an island or about memory rather than phones, this could steer viewers toward a technology plot that is not there.

sees: A grid of tilted dark slate cards or tiles, each with two light gray lines like placeholder text, fills the frame. The silhouette girl is seen from behind, in front of them. Same header.
message: The narrator talks about many pieces of information, memories or stories the girl is trying to sort through.
wouldConfuse: The cards carry no real text, so they could mean notes, memories, letters, files or lies. The gray lines look like unfinished placeholders. The cards also overlap the header badge.

sees: The brown-skinned glasses girl, now shown from the waist up in an orange hooded top, gestures with her arm toward an open dark book with lined pages in the lower right. Target rings and an A-frame are in the background. Same header.
message: The narrator presents the book itself, or says the girl is telling or reading her own story.
wouldConfuse: The open book could be read as the novel 'We Were Liars' itself, as a diary, or as studying or school. Her neutral expression gives no emotional cue.

sees: The same glasses girl in an orange hoodie stands centered and smiles, with her arms at her sides, in front of target rings, a gray bar, a small gray dot and an A-frame. There is no header badge or title in this frame.
message: The narrator welcomes viewers or introduces the girl as the main character in a friendly way.
wouldConfuse: This is the only frame without the 'INSIGHT / WE WERE LIARS' header, so it may look like a different section, an intro, or an outro. Her cheerful smile may not match the tone of the narration.

sees: The black silhouette girl points at a large dark navy heart shape on the right. Target rings are in the background. Same header.
message: The narrator says the girl is in love or talks about a romance or strong feelings.
wouldConfuse: A plain heart could mean romance, family love, or heartbreak. Dark navy on a crosshair target background could even read as 'love as a target' or grief, so the exact feeling is unclear.

sees: The glasses girl in an orange hoodie, with a slight smile, is on the left. On the lower right, bold concentric rings form a bullseye with a dark center dot, overlapping a faint A-frame. Same header.
message: The narrator is pointing out the key point, focus or central goal of the girl's story.
wouldConfuse: A bullseye or target reads as 'goal', 'focus' or 'being targeted', and it blends into the target rings that are already in the background, so it is hard to tell whether this is a new idea or just decoration.
